name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Chemical, Graphene, and Multimeter belong to different engineers.
Between Graphene and Steel, one goes with Bell and the other with Hertz.
Welder goes with none of Watt, Civil, or Concrete.
Between Steel and Wrench, one goes with Hertz and the other with Watt.
